title: ezFilter
description: An easy, customizable chat filter for you minecraft server. With a Discord logging option.
body: **EzFilter** is a powerful and easy-to-use Minecraft plugin designed to help server administrators maintain a clean and respectful chat environment. With customizable word filtering, a warning system, and seamless Discord integration, EzFilter provides all the tools you need to manage chat effectively. Players attempting to use banned words will be warned, kicked, or banned based on configurable thresholds, and all actions can be logged to a Discord webhook. Perfect for servers of all sizes, EzFilter ensures your community stays safe and enjoyable for everyone.
